case_number: 2025 INSC 379; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C) NO.5505 of 2020)

parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh and Others

summary: Appointment in excess of advertised posts; termination upheld, but salary claim for 8 years of actual service allowed; Article 226 jurisdiction not barred by need for civil action; High Court's hyper-technical approach rejected; reliance on ABL International Ltd. precedent; salary with 6% interest and costs of Rs.1 lakh awarded.
legal_provisions_cited: ABL International Ltd. v. Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India Ltd.
Zonal Manager, Central Bank of India v. Devi Ispat Limited
Real Estate Agencies v. State of Goa
Popatrao Vyankatrao Patil v. State of Maharashtra
Unitech Limited v. Telangana State Industrial Infrastructure Corporation
National Company v. Territory Manager, Bharat Petroleum Corporation
State of Uttar Pradesh v. Sudhir Kumar Singh
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgments set aside; respondents directed to pay salary with 6% interest and costs of Rs.1 lakh within three months.
